name: ollama
description: Get up and running with Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
readme: Start building with open models. Access the latest releases locally or in the cloud with complete privacy. The official Ollama Docker image ollama/ollama is available on Docker Hub. You'll be prompted to run a model or connect Ollama to your existing agents or applications such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode , Codex, Copilot, and more.
